top_concerns: Hyperparameters tuned at one near-Chinchilla horizon and frozen for longer runs; tuning effort is unequal across methods, and rankings flip with re-tuning of betas (SOAP vs AdEMAMix)
Single-seed validation losses with no confidence intervals, while many top-method gaps are only 0.01-0.03
Scale limited to <=720M parameters and about 50B tokens, with one small untuned MoE; claims about LLM pretraining and practitioner guidance may not extrapolate
Validation loss only, with no downstream evaluation and no cost (memory/time-to-target) normalization for AdEMAMix and SOAP
Some causal explanations (Muon vs D-Muon weight decay, Prodigy and Lion mechanisms) are asserted without isolating ablations; limited novelty and a 'first' benchmark claim
